description: Change when a time entry started and/or ended, or when a running timer started. Only those times change: the comment, tags and type stay, and so do the activity's other entries. The stretches of a paused timer are entries like any other and can be moved. To move one entry, pass its interval_id and activity_id from list_intervals. Without interval_id: for a running timer, `from` moves when its current stretch started ("I actually started at 19:10"; activity_id from get_current_status); for a paused or stopped activity, `from` moves its first entry's start and `to` its last entry's end. A running timer has no end yet: to end it in the past, use stop_activity with `at`. Times are wall-clock in the user's timezone: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm", or "HH:mm" for the entry's own day.

activity_id.description: activity_id from list_intervals, or an active timer's id from get_current_status (internal — never show ids to the user)

from.description: New start, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm" or "HH:mm"; unchanged when omitted

interval_id.description: id of the entry from list_intervals; omit to move a running timer's start or an activity's first/last entry (internal — never show ids to the user)

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the times (default: the user's)

to.description: New end, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm" or "HH:mm"; unchanged when omitted

name: update_interval
title: Change entry times
